verdict.rationale: The evidence describes a server that 01's own clients (mobile apps, ESP32, desktop) connect to, plus profile-file customization. None of it documents a public API that a user or program could call directly, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 at every candidate path. A server talking to first-party clients and an llms.txt docs index are adjacent material, not a documented public API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
